header: Use Microsoft Sentinel functions, saved queries, and custom rules
content:
queries, and custom rules
Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel in the Microsoft Defender portal
This article explains how to use Microsoft Sentinel functions, saved queries, and custom rules in
advanced hunting in the Microsoft Defender portal.
To use a Microsoft Sentinel function, go to the Functions tab and scroll until you find the
function that you want. Double-click the function name to insert the function in the query
editor.
You can also select the vertical ellipses (
) to the right of the function and select Insert to
query to insert the function into a query in the query editor.
Other options include:
View details – Opens the function side pane containing its details.
Load function code – Opens a new tab containing the function code.
For editable functions, more options are available when you select the vertical ellipses:
Edit details – Opens the function side pane to allow you to edit details about the function
(except folder names for Sentinel functions).
Delete – Deletes the function.
Use the adx()  operator to query tables stored in Azure Data Explorer. For more information,
see What is Azure Data Explorer?
Previously, this feature was only available in log analytics in Microsoft Sentinel. Now, users can
use the operator in advanced hunting in the unified Microsoft Defender portal without needing
to manually open a Microsoft Sentinel window.
In the query editor, enter the query in the following format:
Kusto
